study_note: Separate paired critics D512-2 random-explorer screen with explorer fraction 1/8 (0.125): 448 P and 64 R rollouts per round. It retains the D512-2 schedule exactly: J=8, N=512, H=3, batch size 512, replay capacity 12,288, phased C=3 primary critic, A=1 primary actor, and T=1 primary automatic-temperature updates per round. P and R each have their own critic, target critic, actor, and automatic temperature. Both critics receive C=3 paired updates per round on the same pooled minibatches, while each actor and temperature receives one update per round. Final real-environment execution always samples P; fixed outer-Q P/R decisions are logged counterfactually. The 14-million-decision budget, seed 55, training-focused evaluation gates, and no-model-checkpoint policy are unchanged. This is a single-seed exploratory cell and supports no confidence, significance, or confirmatory claim.
